description_json.name: Vowel-Consonant Alternating Shift
description_json.idea: To improve semantic coherence and reasoning capability for the model, we use a simple, highly structured rule-based shift that treats vowels and consonants differently. Vowels are shifted to the next vowel in the sequence (a->e->i->o->u->a), and consonants are shifted to the next consonant in the alphabet sequence, skipping vowels. Case is preserved. Non-letters remain unchanged. This maintains the readable structure of words while completely changing their spelling, making it easy for the model to decode and reason.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Define vowels as 'aeiou' and consonants as 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz'.
2. For any uppercase letter, determine its lowercase equivalent, apply the shift, and restore uppercase.
3. If a character is a vowel, replace it with the next vowel in the circular sequence: a->e, e->i, i->o, o->u, u->a.
4. If a character is a consonant, replace it with the next consonant in the circular consonant sequence: b->c, c->d, ..., z->b (skipping vowels).
5. All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
1. Define vowels as 'aeiou' and consonants as 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz'.
2. For any uppercase letter, determine its lowercase equivalent, apply the reverse shift, and restore uppercase.
3. If a character is a vowel, replace it with the previous vowel in the circular sequence: a->u, e->a, i->e, o->i, u->o.
4. If a character is a consonant, replace it with the previous consonant in the circular consonant sequence: b->z, c->b, d->c, ..., z->y (skipping vowels).
5. All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain unchanged.

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
